name: cashlayer-private-payroll
description: CashLayer Private Payroll on Avalanche L1 using eERC Standard

scripts.contracts:build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.USERPROFILE + '\\.foundry\\bin;' + process.env.PATH; execSync('forge build', { cwd: 'contracts', env: { ...process.env, PATH: p }, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.contracts:test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.USERPROFILE + '\\.foundry\\bin;' + process.env.PATH; execSync('forge test -vvv', { cwd: 'contracts', env: { ...process.env, PATH: p }, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.contracts:clean: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.USERPROFILE + '\\.foundry\\bin;' + process.env.PATH; execSync('forge clean', { cwd: 'contracts', env: { ...process.env, PATH: p }, stdio: 'inherit' });"

author: CashLayer Team
